title: Herfindahl-Hirschman Concentration Index for the Foundation-Model Dependency Graph

original_idea.body:
# Herfindahl-Hirschman Concentration Index for the Foundation-Model Dependency Graph

Scrape public catalogues (OpenRouter usage, HuggingFace lineage, model-card base-model fields) to estimate how downstream derivatives concentrate on a few base models, compute HHI plus a lineage Gini, and map single points of systemic failure. Pure data analysis, zero GPU.

theory_of_impact.reasoning: Level 3: plausible chain (HHI makes concentration risk legible) but it's a descriptive metric with an indirect catastrophic link.

accessible_complexity.reasoning: Level 5: scrape public metadata, compute HHI/Gini; pure data analysis, zero GPU, beginner-accessible.

narrow_scope.reasoning: Level 4: focused deliverable (concentration index + dependency map) but data scraping/cleaning is a real dependency.

counterfactual_value.reasoning: Level 4: public metadata only, regulator-adoptable monitoring tool labs underweight, no internal access.

novelty.reasoning: An HHI/dependency-graph concentration index for foundation models appears largely novel.

novelty_assessment.reasoning: No known HHI-style concentration index for the foundation-model dependency graph.
